_notes: Fixtures for standalone testing of LLM Gateway (n8n/workflows/llm-gateway.json) and Triage Pipeline (n8n/workflows/triage-pipeline.json), per 004-triage design.md NFR1/AC3/AC2/AC5. Use `normal` and `malformed_empty_body` as pinData on Triage Pipeline's Execute Workflow Trigger node (mirrors 002-ingestion's email-normaliser.json pinData pattern). `invalid_category_mock` is not a Triage Pipeline input — it is a canned LLM Gateway *response* to pin on the 'Call LLM Gateway' node when testing Triage Pipeline's FR5 validation/rejection path (AC5) without depending on Gemini actually returning an out-of-set value live.

normal.subject: Re: Weekly sync - 3 PM tomorrow?
normal.body:
Hi team,

Just confirming our sync is still on for 3 PM tomorrow. Let me know if that no longer works for anyone.

Thanks,
Alex

invalid_category_mock._notes: Pin this as 'Call LLM Gateway' node output when exercising Triage Pipeline's category-validation path (FR5/AC5). Simulates the model returning a value outside the five-value allow-list -- Triage Pipeline must reject this and write triage_error, never write 'urgent' to emails.category.

data.summary: Needs a reply about tomorrow's sync time.

oversized_summary_mock._notes: Pin this as 'Call LLM Gateway' node output to exercise Triage Pipeline's summary shape guard (FR9/AC5-adjacent). A valid category paired with a summary that fails the shape check (too long, contains a URL) must also be rejected -- never written truncated or as-is.

data.summary: This summary is deliberately far too long to pass the one-line, one-hundred-and-sixty-character shape guard defined in FR9, and it also contains a link: https://example.com/click-here which should independently fail the no-URL check.
